definitions.explanation: Significantly changing or rebuilding the structure of a building or object.
Altering a machine, vehicle, or device to change its function or appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改造|かいぞう}して⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in an old house that has been remodeled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改造|かいぞう}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧{改造|かいぞう}された⟦{バイク|ばいく}→バイク：05081_baiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{倉庫|そうこ}を{改造|かいぞう}してカフェにした。
examples.english: They remodeled a warehouse into a cafe.

examples.japanese: {築|ちく}50{年|ねん}の{建物|たてもの}を{改造|かいぞう}して、モダンなオフィスに{生|う}まれ{変|か}わらせた。
examples.english: They remodeled the 50-year-old building and transformed it into a modern office.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{改造|かいぞう}して{性能|せいのう}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I modified my computer to improve its performance.

notes:
{改造|かいぞう} implies significant structural changes, not just minor repairs or adjustments.

Common collocations:
- {改造|かいぞう}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (modified car)
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{改造|かいぞう} (cabinet reshuffle)
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧{改造|かいぞう} (illegal modification)
- {改造|かいぞう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (renovation work)

Related terms:
- リフォーム (renovation - mainly for homes)
- カスタム (custom modification)
- ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧ (repair - fixing, not changing)
- ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧ (refurbishment - focus on appearance)
